summary: My advisory is repaired verbatim: the condition-1 clause now reads 'This file existing, or an ACCEPT verdict, is not owner recording', adopting the sibling DR-005 wording I proposed, which closes the one route by which this verdict could be mistaken for the owner recording condition 1 requires. Beyond that, the artifact carries a repair I did not ask for and would have raised had I caught it: P-008-2's bound applied CD-RT-5's retention posture to Operational metadata in v1, which is the same state-class collapse Codex found in the DR-005 sibling, and v2 fixes it — the preview may cache a non-authoritative working copy of the decided values inside Operational metadata, but 'This does not apply CD-RT-5's retention lifecycle to Operational metadata, does not alter the posture, and is not the EVIDENCE/D9 join.' Applying a sibling's blocker as a class across the family is the right discipline and it is visible in the bytes. Everything I verified at v1 is intact, including the register-lag disclosure, which I re-tested element by element.
